verdict.rationale: Recurly's Dunning Management controls which emails are sent, when retries occur, and what happens if a subscriber never pays, with up to 50 targeted campaigns. Recurly Engage adds payment-failure flows with in-app prompts. The evidence does not show email branding, configurable grace periods, or an explicit cancel-vs-unpaid final-state choice. Missing for 10: documented branded/customizable dunning email templates, explicit grace-period configuration, explicit cancel vs unpaid final-state options, and hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can configure automated dunning sequences — branded emails, in-app banners, grace periods, and final-state rules like cancel vs unpaid

citations.quote: Dunning Management controls how Recurly handles failed payments — what emails are sent, when retries occur, and what happens if a subscriber never pays.
merchants on Professional and Elite plans can create up to 50 targeted campaigns for different customer segments or plans
It details how to set up targeted in-app prompts to help users update their payment information and reduce involuntary churn.
Recurly appears to offer more automated customer retention features (no need to implement webhooks to send dunning emails).
